sections.description:
BALOCHISTAN CIVIL SERVANTS (APPOINTMENT, PROMOTION AND TRANSFER) RULES,
2009
BALOCHISTAN CIVIL SERVANTS (APPOINTMENT, PROMOTION
AND TRANSFER) RULES, 2009
(Amendment of R.13)
[Gazette of Balochistan Extraordinary,
8th November, 2018]
No.
SO(R-I)5(39)S&GAD-2018/2378-2477, dated 8.11.2018.--In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 25
of the Balochistan Civil Servants Act, 1974 (Act No. IX of 1974), the
Government of Balochistan is pleased to make the following amendment in the
Balochistan Civil Servants (Appointment, Promotion and Transfer) Rules, 2009,
namely:-
in the aforesaid rules:-
in rule 13, in sub-rule (1), the
following shall be substituted, namely:-
"Five percent (5%) of total number
of posts in all Government departments, shall be reserved for disabled persons,
as provided under subsection (3) of Section 10 of the Balochistan Disabled
Persons with Disabilities Act, 2017 (Act No. II of 2017), in case the vacancies
reserved for Disabled Persons cannot be filled on account of non-availability
of qualified Disabled applicants, on having been advertised twice, the said
vacancies shall be treated as non-reserved and filled on open provincial
merit."
